An Essay on the Principle of Population by Thomas Robert Malthus

"An Essay on the Principle of Population" by Thomas Robert Malthus presents a seminal examination of the relationship between population growth and food supply, positing that population tends to increase geometrically while food supply grows arithmetically. Malthus argues that this imbalance will inevitably lead to widespread poverty and hardship unless mitigated by societal mechanisms.
